_comment: Example flight plan. Copy to backend/data/roadmap.json and edit — dates, legs, and weekly rhythm are yours to shape. The app falls back to this file when no personal plan exists.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.motto: Wheels up. Build the habit before the ambition.
phases.code: Arrays & hashing, two pointers, sliding window, stack, binary search
phases.design: Interview meta-skills: how interviews are graded, clarify → approach → code → test
phases.dgx: Inference lab: serve a small model locally, baseline benchmark (tok/s, TTFT)
phases.read: A deep-dive article on how an inference request flows through a serving stack
phases.story: Draft behavioral (STAR) stories until you have a bank of 10

phases.name: Core I
phases.motto: Gaining altitude — trees, heaps, and your first real designs.
phases.design: Classic system designs: rate limiter, URL shortener, news feed — one per week on paper
phases.dgx: KV-cache deep-dive: read the PagedAttention paper, measure cache growth vs context length
phases.story: Rehearse one STAR story out loud weekly

phases.name: Core II
phases.motto: Steady state. Graphs below, quantization ahead.
phases.design: More designs + an intro to ML system design
phases.dgx: Quantization experiments: FP8 / INT8 / AWQ — quality vs throughput curves
phases.story: Rehearse one STAR story out loud weekly

phases.name: Flagship build
phases.motto: The leg that shows up on your resume.
phases.design: GenAI designs: RAG pipeline, LLM API with rate limiting, evals + guardrails
phases.dgx: FLAGSHIP: build a serving stack — router, continuous batching, metrics — and write it up
phases.read: Your own benchmark notes — turn them into writeup sections
phases.story: Rehearse one STAR story out loud weekly

phases.name: Mocks & depth
phases.motto: Shake the airframe on purpose. Better here than in the loop.
phases.code: Timed mediums (35-min cap) + redo weak topics; math & bit manipulation
phases.design: Weekly mock out loud — alternate classic and ML system design
phases.dgx: A stretch experiment: speculative decoding, or a first custom GPU kernel

phases.name: Loop-ready
phases.code: Company-tagged problems for your target list
phases.design: Full mock loops: system design + ML system design back-to-back
phases.dgx: Polish the flagship writeup into interview talking points
